title: Naturality of objectwise normalized scalar fibre maps
statement: Fix a field $k$, a prime $\ell$ invertible in $k$, and a coherent continuous rational realization family $R$. Use the separated finite-type $k$-bases, their actual localized rational hearts and scalar functors, normalized geometric fibres and pullback data of [def-per-adic-fibre-comparison-data], [def-per-adic-fibre-coherence-data], [def-per-adic-normalized-fibre-data] and [lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-pullback], and the actual finite scalar quotients and reduction-cone maps of [def-zl-normalized-adic-fibre-limit-data]. Given any normalized fibre family $\omega$ and objectwise scalar components $d$ [def-per-scalar-fibre-component-data], every heart arrow $f:F\to G$ satisfies $\omega_{B,x}(T_if)\,d_G=d_F\,(B\otimes_A\omega_{A,x}(f))$ for every finite coefficient embedding $i:A\to B$, finite-type base and geometric point. This asserts naturality only, and constructs no components or coherence equations.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(1),(4),(6), Proposition 6.8.14, Remark 6.8.15; scalar fibre construction and tensor normalization

proof.text: Choose a common adapted stratification and a pointed affine etale chart for both objects. Full faithfulness of completed lisse rationalization represents a heart arrow there by an integral lattice map divided by a uniformizer power.

For an integral map the finite stalk scalar formula sends both composites on a tensor of a germ to the germ of the same tensor section. Pass through all quotient projections and the completion-cone equation of d. Joint monicity yields integral naturality. Apply the normalized fibre fraction equation to divide both routes by the same scalar; the annihilating-power equality criterion removes dependence on fraction representatives. Conjugation by the fractional lattice comparison on a common refinement returns this equation to the original fibre functors.

theorem scalar_fibre_naturality (ω : Fibres (k := k) l R)
    (d : ScalarFibreComponents l R ω)
    (A B : Type u) [Field A] [Field B] [Algebra ℚ_[l] A] [Algebra ℚ_[l] B]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] A] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] B]
    (i : A →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] B) (X : FiniteTypeBase k)
    (κ : Type u) [Field κ] [IsAlgClosed κ] (x : Spec (.of κ) ⟶ X.scheme)
    (F G : NormalizedFibre.Heart l A (base l X)) (f : F ⟶ G) :
    ((ω B X).point κ x).functor.map ((heartScalar l A B i X).map f) ≫
        (d.component A B i X κ x G).hom =
      (d.component A B i X κ x F).hom ≫
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars i.toRingHom).map (((ω A X).point κ x).functor.map f)
